project.name: Smart Pets
project.tagline: Dogs (and later cats) with judgment, personality, genetics and a bond that grows.
project.stage: Pre-alpha — design and toolchain. No playable build yet.

phases.name: V0 — Foundations
phases.summary: Prove the toolchain and the hardest unknowns before building features.

items.name: Consolidated design spec and gap review
Executable behavior specs (67 scenarios, decision table)
Toolchain, headless tests and in-game observation (S0)
Custom entity, model and animation spike
Persistence, catch-up and 'go home' travel spikes

phases.name: V1 — The Dog
phases.summary: Singleplayer dog: judgment, needs, genetics, training by cues, wild conquest, orphan puppies, sleep and home.

items.name: Judgment and safety (never attacks you or allies)
Training by cues, mastery and skills
Wild dog conquest and orphan puppies

phases.name: V2 — The Cat
phases.summary: Independent cats with affection, naps, warm spots and their own life.

items.name: Cat behavior, affection and coexistence with dogs

phases.name: V3 — Multiplayer
phases.summary: Bond per person, co-guardians, anti-theft rules.
